title: Ban on Styrofoam Packaging in Hawker Centres
what_it_is: Ban on Styrofoam Packaging in Hawker Centres

sections.label: Hawker stall crockery and styrofoam
sections.summary: Most hawker stalls use reusable crockery, but some hawkers still use polystyrene foam disposable wares, which Singapore incinerates at waste-to-energy plants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The majority of our hawker stalls use reusable crockery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: However, disposable wares made of polystyrene foam, commonly known as styrofoam, are still used by some hawkers to serve food and pack food for takeaways, due to its good thermal insulation and convenience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In Singapore, however, all incinerable waste, including polystyrene foam packaging, is incinerated safely at waste-to-energy incineration plants, which are fitted with pollution control equipment.

sections.label: Discouraging disposable tableware in hawker centres
sections.summary: The Ministry will continue to look into ways to discourage the use of disposable tableware in hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry will continue to look into ways to discourage the use of disposable tableware in hawker centres.

sections.label: Costs of disposable and reusable wares
sections.summary: Other disposable wares cost two to three times more than polystyrene foam packaging, but reusable crockery is more cost-effective, and hawkers are being discouraged from disposable wares.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Basically, for commonly used disposable wares in the hawker centres, the cost of the other types of disposable wares, for instance, plastic containers or coated paper box or even the "tze char"	paper box, they are about two to three times higher in cost than the clamshell polystyrene foam packaging.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But using reusable crockery, including taking into account the cost of manual collection and washing of reusable crockery, is actually more cost-effective and relatively cheaper, compared to using styrofoam packaging.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we do not face this problem about Styrofoam packaging being landfilled as it is incinerated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are working with the hawkers, through the hawker associations and stalls to discourage them from using disposable wares, including polystyrene foam packaging, as much as possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As much as possible, we will encourage them to not use disposable wares, particularly for dining in.
